extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, key personnel, and grants administrators preparing NIH (SBIR Phase II) biographical sketches and Research & Related budgets/budget justifications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare NIH-format biographical sketches for senior/key personnel and complete Research & Related budget forms and a narrative budget justification for an SBIR Phase II grant application. Includes required fields, page limits, budget categories, and supporting narrative detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include NAME, eRA COMMONS USERNAME, POSITION TITLE, EDUCATION/TRAINING (begin with baccalaureate and include postdoctoral training). For education include INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), YEAR(s), and FIELD OF STUDY. Present each person on the provided format and adhere to the four-page maximum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (biographical sketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement describing the overarching goal of the application and the individual's role and contributions to the project (example begins: 'The overarching goal of this application entitled, "Point of Care HIV Antigen/Antibody Diagnostic Device", is to...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain specific responsibilities (e.g., provide clinical samples, maintain recruitment program), relevant collaborations, leadership roles, mentoring activities, and linkage of clinical/behavioral data and banked specimens. Cite pertinent past work/publications that support capability to carry out the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: List academic and professional positions with date ranges (e.g., Associate Physician, Assistant Adjunct Professor, Associate Professor, Professor in Residence) and dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also list current national/scientific committees and service (e.g., WHO committees, editorial boards) to document leadership and service relevant to the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: List selected publications pertinent to the proposed topic (the example lists fifteen publications selected from over 80 peer-reviewed manuscripts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full citations and, where available, PMCID/PMID. Highlight the most relevant items by number or annotation (e.g., 'especially #s 1, 3, 7, 9, 12, 14, 15').

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Ongoing and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe ongoing and completed research support by grant number, funding agency, project title, and project period. For each entry include 'Major goals' that summarize the aims of the funded project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include start and end dates and clearly label entries as 'Ongoing Research Support' or 'Completed Research Support'. Provide enough detail to show relevance to the proposed project (e.g., cohorts, data sources, infrastructure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section A & B (Senior/Key Person and Other Personnel)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide budget entries for Senior/Key Person and Other Personnel including Project Role, Base Salary, Academic Months, Calendar Months, Sum Months, Requested Salary, Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the number of personnel, project roles, percent effort (cal. months/academic months), and total funds requested for all senior/key persons and other personnel; follow the RESEARCH & RELATED Budget Section A & B fields exactly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment (Section C) — threshold and listing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an equipment itemized list with funds requested for each item above the $5,000 threshold and include a total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel (Section D) — categories to report
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs, and compute a Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out per-trip or per-person cost elements in the budget justification (e.g., transportation, lodging, meals) as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Section E)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide support cost categories for participants/trainees including Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and Number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute a Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs value and include supporting detail in the justification or attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs (Section F) — standard categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs such as Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List line items and funds requested for each category and provide supporting explanations in the budget justification attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs (Section G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Total Direct Costs as the sum of Sections A through F.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the total direct costs reflect and reconcile to the detailed line-item budgets and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs (Section H)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report the Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and the total Indirect Costs. Provide the Cognizant Federal Agency contact as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the indirect cost type (e.g., MTDC on-campus) and include the appropriate rate and base used to calculate indirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct and Indirect Costs (Section I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report the Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This should match the sum of the computed direct and indirect costs reported elsewhere in the budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee (Section J) — allowable fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Include any allowed fee; example document states inclusion of the allowed 7% fee in the budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate the fee on the allowable base per program rules (example: 7% calculated on MBio Direct and Indirect costs, excluding the UCSD subaward). Confirm program-specific rules for fee calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification (Section K) — file and narrative requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Budget Justification attachment (Only attach one file.). Include narrative description of personnel, supplies, travel, equipment, consultants, and other direct costs. Indicate Indirect Cost Type and Funds Requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justify personnel effort and roles, explain supplies/reagent cost calculations, tooling/instrument component costs, travel plans and per-person cost assumptions, consultant needs and scope, and any other special cost assumptions. Include file name and mime type when uploading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Personnel detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe key personnel by name/title, role on the project, relevant expertise, and percent effort (e.g., 'Dr. Lochhead... will commit 5% effort'; 'Dr. Nieuwlandt... commits 40% effort').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For other personnel describe positions, candidate examples (if applicable), expected duties, and percent effort for each (e.g., Associate Scientist full time; Research Associate 50%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Supplies and reference test costing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide supplies worksheets and explain antibody and reagent cost calculations; reference test kits should be costed based on prior experience (example: 4th generation HIV Ag/Ab Combo assays cost > $ per microplate in Phase I experience).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show analytes/reagents, labeling kits, repeat orders, price per order, and totals. Explain major recurring supply cost drivers (e.g., reference test kits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Tooling and Instrument Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe tooling and supplies for instrument development (e.g., cartridge mold, lid mold, blister pack vendor support, instrument builds). Provide cost estimates and assumptions (e.g., number of mold revisions, per-unit instrument build costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain vendor selection and previous experience, number of iterations budgeted, and how costs are allocated across years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Travel assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: State travel plans (example: anticipate two trips per year; one trip for two people to clinical collaborators) and show per-person budgets for transportation, lodging, and meals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals by trip and by year, and explain purpose (e.g., coordinate field evaluation, sample transfers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Consultants and regulatory support
rubrics_metrics.description: Request funding for specific consultants (example: regulatory support for pre-market approval (PMA) through CBER at FDA) and identify consultant firms (example: Myraqa) and budgeted amounts per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe scope of consultant work, regulatory milestones targeted, and how consultant input will be used in product development and regulatory submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward budget form requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Subaward budgets must mirror the Research & Related sections: provide Subaward organization name, start/end dates, senior/key persons (with roles, effort, requested salary and fringe), other personnel, equipment, travel, participant costs, other direct costs, indirect costs (including indirect cost rate and base), total direct and indirect costs, and attach a budget justification file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include tracking numbers, OMB number expiration as applicable, and indicate any on-campus MTDC indirect rate or other negotiated rates; provide a single budget justification file (example: 1234-UCSDBudgetJustification.pdf).
